basic_info.description: Tucked away on a tranquil block in Buena Vista, this 1-bedroom, 1-bath condominium offers the best of both worlds - a peaceful retreat with immediate access to some of San Francisco's most dynamic neighborhoods. From here, you're just moments from the energy of the Divisadero Corridor, the color of the Haight, the vibrancy of the Castro, and the charm of Lower Haight. Inside, sunshine streams through oversized windows, filling the condo with warmth and light. The heart of the home is a beautifully updated kitchen that opens effortlessly into the living area, setting the stage for easy gatherings and everyday comfort. The spacious bedroom is equally bright, with natural light pouring in from the south and west to create a serene sanctuary. The large, updated bathroom with double sinks adds a touch of modern comfort, while a shared patio and sauna provide an inviting spot to gather with friends or simply relax under the open sky. With vintage 1905 character, thoughtful updates, and a location that's both quiet and incredibly connected, this home is a rare finda city haven with Buena Vista Park & Duboce Park plus every convenience & cultural experience just moments away.
